_note: Chapter 11 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: He was absent from the meeting because of a bad cold.
ex.cn: 他因为重感冒没有出席这次会议。
ex.note: be absent from 缺席；absent-minded 心不在焉的

ex.en: It took him months to accustom himself to the cold early mornings.
ex.cn: 他花了好几个月才习惯那些清冷的清晨。
ex.note: accustom oneself to (doing) sth. 使自己习惯于某事

ex.en: I admire the way she keeps calm under pressure.
ex.cn: 我佩服她在压力下保持镇定的样子。
ex.note: admire sb./sth. for sth. 因某事钦佩某人或某物

ex.en: Our travel agent arranged the tickets for us.
ex.cn: 我们的旅行社替我们订好了票。
ex.note: an agent of … …的代理人；a sales agent 销售代理

ex.en: The weather may alter our plans for the weekend.
ex.cn: 天气可能会改变我们的周末计划。
ex.note: alter sth. 改变某事；alter the course of … 改变…的进程

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while jogging in the park.
ex.cn: 她在公园慢跑时扭伤了脚踝。
ex.note: twist one's ankle 扭伤脚踝；ankle-deep 没到脚踝

ex.en: The audience applauded warmly when the young singer finished.
ex.cn: 年轻歌手唱完时，观众热烈鼓掌。
ex.note: applaud sb./sth. 为某人或某事鼓掌；applaud a decision 赞同一项决定

ex.en: I will arrange the meeting for Friday afternoon.
ex.cn: 我会把会议安排在周五下午。
ex.note: arrange for sb. to do sth. 安排某人做某事；arrange a meeting 安排会面

ex.en: The whole plan was built on the assumption that prices would stay low.
ex.cn: 整个计划都建立在价格会保持低位的假定之上。
ex.note: on the assumption that … 基于…的假设；make an assumption 作出假定

ex.en: The old automobile parked in front of the gate belonged to the village head.
ex.cn: 停在大门口的那辆旧汽车是村长的。

ex.en: He bought a bunch of bananas at the market on the way home.
ex.cn: 回家路上，他在市场上买了一串香蕉。

ex.en: Small fishing boats were anchored in the bay all morning.
ex.cn: 整个上午，小渔船都停泊在海湾里。
ex.note: the Bay of Bengal 孟加拉湾；a bay of windows 一排窗户

ex.en: The school bell rang and the children ran into the yard.
ex.cn: 铃声响了，孩子们跑进了操场。
ex.note: ring the bell 打铃；a dinner bell 晚餐铃声

ex.en: She dipped the biscuit into her tea and took a small bite.
ex.cn: 她把饼干在茶里蘸了一下，咬了一小口。

ex.en: The bomb was found in the old warehouse by a demolition team.
ex.cn: 拆除小组在旧仓库里发现了那枚炸弹。
ex.note: a bomb scare 炸弹恐慌；drop a bomb 扔下重磅消息

ex.en: The planes bombed the port before the troops landed.
ex.cn: 部队登陆之前，飞机轰炸了港口。
ex.note: be bombed 被轰炸；bombing raid 空袭

ex.en: We bought bread and eggs on the way back to the hostel.
ex.cn: 回宿舍的路上，我们买了面包和鸡蛋。
ex.note: bread and butter 涂黄油的面包；a bread winner 养家糊口的人

ex.en: The bullet went through the door without hitting anyone.
ex.cn: 子弹穿过门，没有打中任何人。
ex.note: a bullet-proof vest 防弹衣

ex.en: Could you call me back after the meeting?
ex.cn: 开完会你能给我回个电话吗？
ex.note: call sb. back 给某人回电话；call on sb. 拜访某人

ex.en: There was a call from the hospital while I was out.
ex.cn: 我出去的时候医院打来了电话。
ex.note: make a call 打电话；a wake-up call 提醒；answer the phone 接电话

ex.en: The old carpet in the hallway had been worn thin by many feet.
ex.cn: 走廊里那块旧地毯被无数双脚踩得磨薄了。
ex.note: sweep sth. under the carpet 遮掩某事

ex.en: The latest census counted a little over ten thousand residents.
ex.cn: 最新的人口普查统计出略略一万多居民。
ex.note: a census of … …的人口普查；take a census 进行人口普查

ex.en: The cheapest tickets were already sold out a week before the show.
ex.cn: 最便宜的票在演出前一周就卖光了。
ex.note: cheap and nasty 廉价而劣质；nothing cheap 绝不便宜

ex.en: They went home for Christmas and stayed until New Year's Day.
ex.cn: 他们回家过圣诞节，一直待到元旦。
ex.note: 圣诞节 Eve 平安夜；Merry 圣诞节 圣诞快乐

ex.en: Click the icon twice and the file will open in a new window.
ex.cn: 点两下图标，文件就会在新窗口里打开。
ex.note: click on 点击；a click of the mouse 鼠标的一声咔哒

ex.en: She collected the signatures of everyone who had taken part in the survey.
ex.cn: 她收集了所有参与调查者的签名。
ex.note: collect data 收集数据；collect on sb. 向某人收款

ex.en: He commutes to the city centre by bus every morning.
ex.cn: 他每天早上坐公交车通勤到市中心。
ex.note: commute to/from 通勤往返；a long commute 漫长的通勤

ex.en: The old comrade greeted him warmly after forty years.
ex.cn: 那位老战友四十年后热情地迎了上来。
ex.note: an old comrade 老战友；a title used in address 同志

ex.en: There is a clear connection between the two accidents.
ex.cn: 这两起事故之间显然存在联系。
ex.note: a connection between … …之间的联系；make a connection 建立联系

ex.en: The mineral content of this water is unusually high.
ex.cn: 这种水的矿物质含量高得反常。
ex.note: the content of … …的内容；content of mind 心满意足

ex.en: She was content to wait until the storm had passed.
ex.cn: 她满足于一直等到风暴过去。
ex.note: be content with 满足于；be content to do 乐于做某事

ex.en: The photograph is protected by copyright and cannot be reused.
ex.cn: 这张照片受版权保护，不得擅自使用。
ex.note: the copyright of … …的版权；be copyrighted 享有版权

ex.en: The photographs are used by courtesy of the museum director.
ex.cn: 这些照片承蒙博物馆馆长慨允使用。
ex.note: by courtesy of 蒙…的好意；as a courtesy 出于礼貌

ex.en: Wait at the crossing until the lights change.
ex.cn: 在十字路口等着，直到信号灯变化。
ex.note: a level crossing 平交道口；a pedestrian crossing 人行横道

ex.en: The little seal was so cute that nobody wanted to leave.
ex.cn: 那只小海豹太可爱了，谁都舍不得走。

ex.en: The class had a short debate about the use of phones in class.
ex.cn: 全班就课堂上使用手机的问题进行了一场简短的辩论。
ex.note: a debate on/about … 关于…的辩论；open a debate 展开辩论

ex.en: The two sides debated the question for the whole evening.
ex.cn: 双方就这个问题辩论了整整一晚。
ex.note: debate sth. 辩论某事；debate with sb. 与某人辩论

ex.en: Bad weather delayed the flight for three hours.
ex.cn: 恶劣天气让航班延误了三个小时。
ex.note: delay sth. 延误某事；a delay of … …的延误；without delay 毫不拖延

ex.en: After that performance, she deserves a long holiday.
ex.cn: 完成那场演奏之后，她值得好好休个长假。
ex.note: deserve to do sth. 应该做某事；deserve sb. sth. 应给某人某物

ex.en: He wrote a few lines in his diary every night before bed.
ex.cn: 他每天晚上睡前都要在日记里写上几句。
ex.note: keep a diary 写日记；a diary entry 一篇日记

ex.en: The boat disappeared into the fog before anyone could call for help.
ex.cn: 还没等有人呼救，那条船就消失在雾里了。
ex.note: disappear from view 从视野中消失；vanish 消失

ex.en: It is hard to distinguish the real change from an error in the machine.
ex.cn: 很难分辨出真正的变化和机器上的误差。
ex.note: distinguish A from B 区分A与B；distinguish oneself 使自己脱颖而出

ex.en: Take one dose every eight hours, and drink plenty of water.
ex.cn: 每八小时服一剂，多喝水。
ex.note: a dose of … 一剂…；in large doses 大剂量地

ex.en: Two fishermen drowned when the boat capsized in the storm.
ex.cn: 风暴中船翻了，两名渔民淹死了。
ex.note: drown in … 淹死在…；drown one's sorrows 借酒消愁

ex.en: The eastern shore of the bay receives the sunrise first.
ex.cn: 海湾东岸最先迎来日出。
ex.note: the eastern part of … …的东部；Eastern Europe 东欧

ex.en: My elder brother taught me to swim when I was six.
ex.cn: 我六岁时，哥哥就教我游泳了。
ex.note: elder 作形容词时指年长的，比较级是 older

ex.en: The village elder was welcomed by the whole community.
ex.cn: 村里的长者受到整个社区的欢迎。
ex.note: one's elders 长辈；an elder statesman 资深政治家

ex.en: The fort was built when the coast was the edge of a great empire.
ex.cn: 这座堡垒建于这片海岸还是一个大帝国边陲的年代。
ex.note: the Roman Empire 罗马帝国；build an empire 建立帝国

ex.en: The village had little entertainment, but the people were never bored.
ex.cn: 村里几乎没有什么可供消遣的东西，可人们从不觉得闷。
ex.note: a form of entertainment 娱乐形式；the entertainment industry 娱乐业

ex.en: Even the youngest student finished the experiment on time.
ex.cn: 连最小的学生都按时完成了实验。
ex.note: even if 即使；even so 即便如此

ex.en: The floor of the hall was smooth and even.
ex.cn: 大厅的地面平滑均匀。
ex.note: an even surface 平坦的表面；an even distribution 均匀的分布；an even number 偶数

ex.en: The news of the prize excited the whole village.
ex.cn: 获奖的消息让整个村子都兴奋起来。
ex.note: excite sb. 使某人激动；excite interest 引起兴趣

ex.en: Take the lid off and expose the wire to the light.
ex.cn: 把盖子打开，让导线露在光线下。
ex.note: expose sth. to sth. 使某物暴露于；expose a mistake 揭露错误

ex.en: Leaves began to fall as soon as the wind rose.
ex.cn: 风一起，叶子就开始落了。
ex.note: fall behind 落后；fall asleep 睡着；fall in love with 爱上

ex.en: In the fall of that year, he started his first job.
ex.cn: 那年秋天，他开始了第一份工作。
ex.note: in the fall 在秋季；a waterfall 瀑布；a fall in price 价格下跌

ex.en: The weather was favorable, so the survey went ahead on time.
ex.cn: 天气不错，调查因此按时进行了。
ex.note: favorable to sth. 有利于某事；a favorable impression 良好的印象

ex.en: Fifty years later, the old fort was still standing.
ex.cn: 五十年后，那座旧堡垒依然矗立。

ex.en: The fox had to flee into the woods as soon as it saw the dog.
ex.cn: 那只狐狸一看见狗就逃进了林子。
ex.note: flee from … 逃离…；flee the scene 逃离现场

ex.en: She wrote down every number for fear of losing it.
ex.cn: 她把每个数字都记下来，生怕弄丢。
ex.note: for prep. 为了；对于；因为；for 支持

ex.en: Foxes are clever animals and often raid the village gardens at night.
ex.cn: 狐狸是聪明的动物，常在夜里闯进村里的菜园。
ex.note: as sly as a fox 像狐狸一样狡猾

ex.en: It was great fun to watch the birds on the cliff.
ex.cn: 看悬崖上的鸟非常有趣。
ex.note: for fun 为了好玩；make a fool of 出丑

ex.en: The children had a fun afternoon building sandcastles on the beach.
ex.cn: 孩子们在沙滩上堆城堡，度过了一个快乐的下午。
ex.note: a fun time 欢乐时光；fun and games 轻松有趣的活动

ex.en: The team packed all its gear before the long trip to the island.
ex.cn: 团队在长途去岛之前把器材都收拾好了。
ex.note: camping gear 露营装备；fishing gear 渔具；gear up 为…做准备

ex.en: He kept a spare pair of gloves in his coat pocket all winter.
ex.cn: 整个冬天他都在外套口袋里放着一副备用手套。
ex.note: a pair of gloves 一副手套；hand in glove with 与…关系密切

ex.en: A grand stone building stood on the headland above the harbour.
ex.cn: 海港上方的岬角上立着一座宏伟的石砌建筑。
ex.note: a grand plan 宏大的计划；grand and glorious 伟大光荣

ex.en: A guard stood at the gate and checked our bags.
ex.cn: 一名警卫站在门口检查我们的包。
ex.note: a prison guard 狱警；a security guard 保安；on guard 戒备着

ex.en: Two soldiers guarded the bridge all through the night.
ex.cn: 两名士兵整夜守卫着那座桥。
ex.note: guard against … 防范…；guard sth. 守卫某物

ex.en: It just happened that the bus arrived at exactly seven.
ex.cn: 碰巧那趟巴士正好七点到了。
ex.note: happen to do 碰巧做某事；as it happens 恰好如此

ex.en: I heard from a friend that the results had been published.
ex.cn: 我从朋友那里听说结果已经发表了。
ex.note: hear of/about 听说；hear from 收到…的消息

ex.en: The highway along the coast was closed for repairs all summer.
ex.cn: 沿海的那条公路整个夏天都在维修封闭。
ex.note: a motorway 高速公路；highway patrol 公路巡警

ex.en: The first set of readings was hopeless, and the team nearly gave up.
ex.cn: 第一批读数毫无希望，团队差点放弃。
ex.note: hopeless at sth. 在某方面毫无希望；a hopeless case 绝症

ex.en: There was no need to hurry, since the tide would not turn until noon.
ex.cn: 不必着急，潮水中午才会转向。
ex.note: in a hurry 匆忙；hurry off 赶快离开；hurry to do 急着做

ex.en: The error disappeared immediately after the wire was replaced.
ex.cn: 导线换掉之后，错误立刻消失了。
ex.note: immediately after 一…之后立刻；immediately following 紧随其后的

ex.en: The work was difficult; indeed, it was the hardest part of the summer.
ex.cn: 这项工作很难；事实上，那是整个夏天最难的部分。
ex.note: Indeed! 的确！；and indeed 事实上

ex.en: A minor injury to his ankle kept him in the lab for two days.
ex.cn: 脚踝上的一点小伤让他在实验室待了两天。
ex.note: an injury to … …的伤害；serious injury 重伤

ex.en: The fort once served the military intelligence unit.
ex.cn: 这座堡垒曾经是军事情报部门的驻地。
ex.note: military intelligence 军事情报；artificial intelligence 人工智能

ex.en: The crack in the wire was almost invisible to the naked eye.
ex.cn: 导线上那道裂缝肉眼看几乎看不见。
ex.note: invisible to the naked eye 肉眼看不见；invisible ink 隐形墨水

ex.en: The article appeared in a small academic journal last spring.
ex.cn: 那篇文章去年春天发表在一本小型学术期刊上。
ex.note: academic journal 学术期刊；keep a journal 写日志

ex.en: A portrait of an old king hung above the museum fireplace.
ex.cn: 一幅老国王的画像挂在壁炉上方。
ex.note: the king of … …之王；king-sized 特大号的

ex.en: The success of the survey was largely due to careful planning.
ex.cn: 调查的成功主要归功于周密的计划。
ex.note: largely because 主要因为；to a large extent 在很大程度上

ex.en: The lease on the old boathouse expires at the end of September.
ex.cn: 那间旧船库的租约九月底到期。
ex.note: a lease on … …的租约；take out a lease 租下

ex.en: The university leased the warehouse to a small research group.
ex.cn: 大学把这座仓库租给了一个小型研究小组。
ex.note: lease sth. from sb. 从某人处租得；lease out 租出

ex.en: The porter lifted the heavy box into the back of the car.
ex.cn: 搬运工把那个沉重的箱子抬上了车后厢。
ex.note: lift sth. up 抬起某物；lift one's head 抬头

ex.en: He took the lift to the top floor of the museum.
ex.cn: 他乘电梯上到博物馆顶楼。
ex.note: take the lift 乘电梯；give sb. a lift 让某人搭便车

ex.en: The local council paid for the equipment in the lab.
ex.cn: 当地政府为实验室的设备付了钱。
ex.note: a local shop 本地商店；local time 当地时间

ex.en: The locals were curious about the young team from the city.
ex.cn: 当地人对城里来的这支年轻队伍很好奇。
ex.note: a local 当事人；the locals 当地人

ex.en: The old man put a lump of sugar into his tea.
ex.cn: 老人往茶里放了一块糖。
ex.note: a lump of sugar 一块糖；a lump in the throat 哽咽

ex.en: We should not lump all these problems together.
ex.cn: 我们不该把这些问题混为一谈。
ex.note: lump A and B together 把A和B归在一起；lump sb. with 把某人归入

ex.en: He spoke in a quiet manner, as if each word cost him something.
ex.cn: 他说话的方式很平静，仿佛每个字都要付出什么。
ex.note: in this manner 以这种方式；manner of speaking 说话的方式

ex.en: Give the book to me when you have finished it.
ex.cn: 你看完之后就把书给我。
ex.note: me 是宾格；let me 让我

ex.en: He was not angry with her, merely disappointed.
ex.cn: 他不是生她的气，只是失望。
ex.note: merely 仅仅；not merely … but also 不仅…而且

ex.en: There was no miracle about the repair; it was slow and careful work.
ex.cn: 这次修复没有什么奇迹可言，只是缓慢而细致的工作。
ex.note: perform miracles 创造奇迹；a miracle cure 神奇疗法

ex.en: The moon rose over the water and lit the whole harbour.
ex.cn: 月亮从水面升起，照亮了整个港口。
ex.note: the moon 月亮；by moonlight 借着月光

ex.en: Soft music from the next room kept her awake for hours.
ex.cn: 隔壁房间里轻柔的音乐让她醒了好几个小时。
ex.note: play music 演奏音乐；music to one's ears 悦耳的音乐

ex.en: A packed lunch was a necessity rather than a luxury.
ex.cn: 自带午餐是必需品，而不是奢侈品。
ex.note: a necessity 必需品；out of necessity 出于无奈

ex.en: The bus ride took ninety minutes each way.
ex.cn: 巴士单程要九十分钟。

ex.en: Nowadays most students carry a laptop to every class.
ex.cn: 如今大多数学生上课都带着笔记本电脑。
ex.note: nowadays 与过去相比；these days 这些日子

ex.en: The work continued into October and beyond.
ex.cn: 工作一直持续到十月之后。
ex.note: in October 在十月；before October 在十月之前

ex.en: The fisherman offered his opinion on the new sea wall.
ex.cn: 那位渔民就新海堤谈了自己的看法。
ex.note: offer/give an opinion 表达意见；in one's opinion 依某人看

ex.en: Nobody could predict the outcome of the experiment.
ex.cn: 没人能预料这次实验的结果。
ex.note: the outcome of … …的结果；a successful outcome 成功的结果

ex.en: He put a packet of biscuits and two pears in his bag.
ex.cn: 他把一小包饼干和两个梨放进包里。
ex.note: a packet of … 一包…；in a packet 包装成小包

ex.en: This particular reading does not fit the pattern of the others.
ex.cn: 这一条具体的读数不符合其他数据的规律。
ex.note: particular about 对…挑剔；in particular 尤其

ex.en: Mark came back from the farm with a paper bag of pears.
ex.cn: 马克从农场回来，带着一纸袋梨。
ex.note: a sweet pear 甜梨；pear wood 梨木

ex.en: The project gave him a new perspective on how science really works.
ex.cn: 这个项目让他对科学究竟如何运作有了新的看法。
ex.note: a new perspective on … 对…的新看法；from a different perspective 从不同的角度

ex.en: A map was pinned to the wall with four small pins.
ex.cn: 一幅地图用四枚小图钉钉在墙上。
ex.note: a safety pin 安全别针；pin it on 钉在…上

ex.en: The professor pinned the photograph to the notice board.
ex.cn: 教授把那张照片钉在了公告板上。
ex.note: pin A to B 把A钉在B上；pin down 明确；pin one's hopes on 把希望寄托在

ex.en: He kept a spare battery in his coat pocket.
ex.cn: 他在外套口袋里放了一节备用电池。
ex.note: pocket money 零花钱；an out-of-pocket expense 自费开支

ex.en: The laboratory was a converted boathouse with two pocket offices.
ex.cn: 实验室是由船库改建的，只有两间小小的办公室。
ex.note: pocket-sized 小小的；pocket money 零花钱

ex.en: A porter helped them carry the equipment down to the car.
ex.cn: 一名搬运工帮他们把器材搬到了车旁。
ex.note: a railway porter 火车站搬运员；a porter's knot 缆绳结

ex.en: He said a short prayer before the meal.
ex.cn: 饭前他念了一段简短的祷词。
ex.note: say a prayer 祈祷；a prayer for peace 为和平祈祷

ex.en: The sensor was cheap and primitive, but it did the job well enough.
ex.cn: 那个传感器又便宜又原始，不过够用了。
ex.note: primitive technology 原始的技术；primitive man 原始人

ex.en: The council called the new harbour a progressive project.
ex.cn: 市政厅把这座新港称为一项进步的工程。
ex.note: progressive ideas 进步的思想；progressive education 渐进式教育

ex.en: The findings were presented at a public meeting in the old fort.
ex.cn: 调查结果是在旧堡的一次公开集会上公布的。
ex.note: public interest 公众利益；public transport 公共交通

ex.en: The general public is rarely invited to such meetings.
ex.cn: 普通公众很少被邀请参加这样的会议。
ex.note: the general public 普通公众；public opinion 舆论

ex.en: He gave a quick nod and sat down again.
ex.cn: 他轻轻点了点头，又坐了回去。
ex.note: a quick glance 一瞥；quick response 迅速的反应；quick-tempered 脾气急躁的

ex.en: The raw data made no sense at all.
ex.cn: 原始数据完全说不通。
ex.note: raw data 原始数据；raw materials 原材料；raw facts 未经加工的事实

ex.en: They kept a complete record of the tide for ten weeks.
ex.cn: 他们为潮汐保存了十周的完整记录。
ex.note: keep a record of … 保存…的记录；a record of achievement 成就的记录

ex.en: She recorded the interview in her notebook.
ex.cn: 她把这段访谈记在笔记本上。
ex.note: record a song 录音；record one's progress 记录进步；动词读作 /rɪˈkɔːd/

ex.en: One student rejected the readings completely and walked out.
ex.cn: 一个学生干脆否认这些读数，走了出去。
ex.note: reject an offer 拒绝提议；reject a candidate 否决候选人

ex.en: He replaced the damaged section of the wire with a new one.
ex.cn: 他用一段新导线换掉了受损的部分。
ex.note: replace A with B 用B替换A；replace sb. 取代某人

ex.en: The response to the team's findings was a long round of applause.
ex.cn: 对团队调查结果的回应是一阵长时间的掌声。
ex.note: in response to 对…的回应；a quick response 迅速的反应

ex.en: Three old rifles stood in a glass case in the museum.
ex.cn: 博物馆的玻璃柜里立着三支旧步枪。
ex.note: a hunting rifle 猎枪；rifle range 射击场

ex.en: By the second week, the daily routine felt almost natural.
ex.cn: 到第二周，日常工作已经几乎变得自然了。
ex.note: a daily routine 日常惯例；go out of routine 脱离常规

ex.en: It was hard work, but at least the work was routine.
ex.cn: 这活儿很累，不过至少是例行的活儿。
ex.note: routine check 例行检查；routine procedure 常规程序

ex.en: The wire had been damaged by salt water from the bay.
ex.cn: 导线被海湾里的咸水腐蚀坏了。
ex.note: salt water 咸水；a pinch of salt 少许盐

ex.en: A scholar who had studied the fort for years gave us a lecture.
ex.cn: 一位研究这座堡垒多年的学者为我们做了讲座。
ex.note: a classical scholar 古典学者；a scholar of the first rank 第一流学者

ex.en: I see what you mean, but the data still puzzle me.
ex.cn: 我明白你的意思，可这组数据还是让我困惑。
ex.note: see to it that … 确保…；see for oneself 亲眼看看

ex.en: Life in the lab settled into a quiet pattern within a month.
ex.cn: 一个月之内，实验室里的日子就沉淀成了一种安静的规律。
ex.note: settle down 安静下来；settle a dispute 解决争端；settle in 安顿下来

ex.en: He felt a shock of pride when the fishermen rose to their feet.
ex.cn: 当渔民们起立时，他心中涌起一阵自豪的震颤。
ex.note: a shock of surprise 大吃一惊；an electric shock 电击

ex.en: The result shocked everyone in the room.
ex.cn: 这个结果让屋里所有人都吃了一惊。
ex.note: shock sb. 使某人震惊；be shocked at 对…感到震惊

ex.en: There was a short silence before the audience began to applaud.
ex.cn: 在听众开始鼓掌之前，有一段短暂的沉默。
ex.note: in silence 沉默地；a long silence 长时间的沉默

ex.en: He silenced the class with a single look.
ex.cn: 他一个眼神就让全班安静下来。
ex.note: silence sb. 使某人闭嘴；silence a noise 消除噪音

ex.en: It was a skillful repair, and it took only ten minutes.
ex.cn: 那是个巧妙的修复，只花了十分钟。
ex.note: be skillful at sth. 擅长某事；skillful in doing sth. 善于做某事

ex.en: Salt water had soaked into the copper and ruined the signal.
ex.cn: 海水渗进了铜丝里，毁掉了信号。
ex.note: soak sth. in … 把…浸泡在…里；soak up 吸收

ex.en: Soon the campus was full again and the classes had begun.
ex.cn: 很快校园又满了，课也开起来了。
ex.note: soon after 不久之后；as soon as 一…就…

ex.en: The moon that night was spectacular, and the village was completely silent.
ex.cn: 那晚的月色壮丽得惊人，整个村子静得彻底。
ex.note: a spectacular success 大获成功；spectacular scenery 壮丽的景色

ex.en: The next readings were stable and could be trusted.
ex.cn: 接下来的读数稳定可靠。
ex.note: stable conditions 稳定的情况；a stable relationship 稳定的关系

ex.en: The horses were kept in a stable behind the farm.
ex.cn: 马被安置在农场后面的马厩里。
ex.note: a horse stable 马厩；ride into the stable 回到马厩

ex.en: The stem of the plant was covered with salt spray.
ex.cn: 植物的茎上覆着一层盐雾。
ex.note: the stem of a plant 植物的茎；the stem of a word 词干

ex.en: The problem seems to stem from a single faulty wire.
ex.cn: 问题似乎源自一根有故障的导线。
ex.note: stem from … 源于…；stem the flow of 阻止…的流动

ex.en: The street outside the lab stayed loud until midnight.
ex.cn: 实验室外面的街道直到午夜都很喧闹。
ex.note: on the street 在街上；a street market 街头市场

ex.en: The survey was a success, and the team received a grant to continue it.
ex.cn: 这次调查很成功，团队还得到了继续调查的经费。
ex.note: a success 成功；success in doing sth. 做某事方面的成功

ex.en: After the meeting there was supper in the courtyard.
ex.cn: 会后，大家在院子里吃晚饭。
ex.note: have supper 吃晚饭；supper time 晚饭时间

ex.en: A young sailor once tried to swim across the bay and drowned.
ex.cn: 从前有个年轻水手想游过海湾，结果淹死了。
ex.note: swim across 游过；go swimming 去游泳

ex.en: She liked to teach by asking questions rather than giving answers.
ex.cn: 她喜欢用提问而不是给答案的方式来教。
ex.note: teach sb. sth. 教某人某事；teach oneself to do 自学做某事

ex.en: The team did in one summer what the council had failed to do in fifty years — a terrific achievement.
ex.cn: 这个团队一个夏天就做成了政府五十年都没做成的事，真是了不起的成就。
ex.note: terrific speed 惊人的速度；a terrific time 玩得痛快

ex.en: The important thing is to keep asking, even when the answer is ugly.
ex.cn: 最重要的是继续追问，哪怕答案并不好看。
ex.note: the thing is … 事情是…；a thing or two 一两件事

ex.en: The tide came in softly, and the boats floated higher.
ex.cn: 潮水轻轻涌进来，船只浮得更高了。
ex.note: high tide 高潮；the tide of affairs 时代的潮流

ex.en: The soup was still hot on his tongue when he heard the news.
ex.cn: 他听到消息时，那口汤在舌头上还是热的。
ex.note: the mother tongue 母语；a forked tongue 分叉的舌头

ex.en: The new wall would transform the whole shoreline.
ex.cn: 那道新堤坝会彻底改变整条海岸线。
ex.note: transform A into B 把A变成B；completely transform 彻底改变

ex.en: He kept an old pair of trousers for work in the field.
ex.cn: 他备着一条旧裤子，好去野外时穿。
ex.note: a pair of trousers 一条裤子；trousers 总是用复数

ex.en: The elder was the uncle of one of the students.
ex.cn: 那位长辈是一名学生的叔叔。
ex.note: uncle and aunt 叔叔阿姨；作称呼时表示亲昵

ex.en: They used an up-to-date program to record the tide.
ex.cn: 他们用一个最新的程序记录潮汐。
ex.note: up-to-date information 最新信息；keep sth. up-to-date 让某事保持最新

ex.en: The professor gave him some valuable advice about the report.
ex.cn: 教授给了他一些关于报告的宝贵建议。
ex.note: valuable advice 宝贵的建议；valuable to sb. 对某人有价值

ex.en: The museum kept its most valuable objects in a locked room.
ex.cn: 博物馆把最贵重的藏品锁在一间上锁的房间里。
ex.note: valuables 贵重物品；insure valuables 为贵重物品投保

ex.en: The guard told them about the violence of the old wars.
ex.cn: 那名警卫向他们讲起旧日战争中的暴行。
ex.note: violence against 对…的暴力；the violence of nature 大自然的暴烈

ex.en: We waited for the tide to turn before going out.
ex.cn: 我们等潮水转向后才出去。
ex.note: wait for sb./sth. 等待；can't wait to do 迫不及待

ex.en: There was a long wait for the results of the survey.
ex.cn: 调查结果让人等了很久。
ex.note: a long wait 漫长的等待；wait and see 走着瞧

ex.en: A spider's web hung in the corner of the room.
ex.cn: 房间角落里挂着一张蜘蛛网。
ex.note: the Web 万维网；a web of lies 谎言之网

ex.en: The village, which had no shop at all, was two miles from the road.
ex.cn: 那个村子什么商店也没有，离公路有两英里。
ex.note: which of … 哪一个；in which 在…中

ex.en: The wire under the tape was cracked and full of salt.
ex.cn: 胶带下面的导线裂了，里面全是盐分。
ex.note: a live wire 带电的电线；by wire 用电报

ex.en: They wired the new sensor to the laptop that afternoon.
ex.cn: 那天下午他们把新传感器接到了笔记本电脑上。
ex.note: wire sth. to sth. 把…连到…上；wire sb. 给某人发电报

ex.en: Without careful checking, the numbers are worthless.
ex.cn: 没有仔细核对，这些数字毫无价值。
ex.note: be worthless 毫无价值；worthless effort 白费力气

ex.en: He came to the coast as a youth and stayed as a scholar.
ex.cn: 他年轻时来到海边，最终留下做了个学者。
ex.note: in one's youth 年轻时；the youth 年轻人
